description: Dynamic DNS / hostname provider definitions with domain and verification metadata

hosts.description: Domains under which the provider hands out hostnames/subdomains. Empty for providers that only host customer-owned domains (own_domains).

old_hosts.description: Retired/discontinued domains formerly offered by this provider

ns_hosts.description: Nameserver hostnames operated by the provider (attribution fingerprint)

ns_suffixes.description: Domain suffixes matching provider nameserver hostnames (e.g. 'afraid.org' matches 'ns1.afraid.org')

status.description: Service lifecycle status: active = open registrations; restricted = signup gated (device ownership, invite-only, manual approval); no_new_registrations = existing hostnames resolve but new ones cannot be created; discontinued = service shut down

type.description: Pricing classification: free/paid/freemium providers, reserved = special-use domains

updates.description: dynamic = supports DDNS update clients; static = records editable but no update protocol; both = dynamic updates plus full static record editing

api.description: Whether a programmatic HTTP/DNS API exists for record management or updates

update_protocols.description: Supported update protocols: dyndns2 = Dyn-compatible nic/update endpoint; http = custom HTTP(S) API; rfc2136 = DNS UPDATE (nsupdate/TSIG); acme-dns01 = ACME DNS-01 challenge support

record_types.description: DNS record types users may set on their hostnames

own_domains.description: Whether users may bring/delegate their own domains (hosts is then non-exhaustive)

shared_registry.description: Whether the provider runs a community-shared domain registry (hosts is a fluid snapshot)

public.description: Whether hostnames can be registered publicly on the provider website. false = registration only via vendor hardware/interface, customer-only, or invite-only.

revalidation_days.description: Interval in days at which free hostnames/accounts must be manually re-confirmed (e.g. 30 for No-IP); absent = none required

expire_days.description: Days without an update after which a hostname is automatically purged (distinct from revalidation_days which requires manual confirmation)

oneOf.description: Verification method required during account creation
Verification methods required during account creation
